automatic_tax_status.description: The automatic tax status of this checkout.

x-enumDescriptions.LOCATION_NOT_SUPPORTED: Automatic tax calculation isn't supported in the customer's location.
x-enumDescriptions.LOCATION_NOT_REGISTERED_BY_MERCHANT: The merchant isn't registered to collect tax in the customer's location.
x-enumDescriptions.ADDRESS_INCOMPLETE: The customer address was insufficient or invalid to determine the correct tax.

back_url.description: If set, the hosted checkout page displays a back button which allows customers to cancel the flow and be directed to this URL.

billing_customer_id.description: ID of the associated billing customer. Billing Checkout will create a new Billing Customer based on information provided during the process, unless an existing billing customer ID was provided when the Billing Checkout was created.

cancelled_at.description: Time when the Billing Checkout was cancelled.

client_secret.description: The client secret used to initialize the Billing Checkout in `EMBEDDED` or `ELEMENTS` `ui_mode`. Only present when `ui_mode` is `EMBEDDED` or `ELEMENTS`.

completed_at.description: Time when the Billing Checkout was completed.

created_at.description: Time when the Billing Checkout was created.

currency.description: The checkout currency in 3-letter ISO-4217 format.

customer_data.description:
The prefilled information of the customer. Only applicable when `billing_customer_id` is not provided.  
Not applicable in `SETUP` mode.

customer_data_collection.description: Provides configuration for the Billing Checkout to collect information from customers.

discounts.description: List of discounts to be applied to the subscription. Discounts of subscription items are applied before subscription discounts. Currently, only one element is supported.

enable_automatic_tax.description: Whether automatic tax is enabled for this checkout. When enabled, the system attempts to calculate taxes for this checkout's invoice automatically.

expires_at.description: Time when the Billing Checkout expires.

hosted_completion_page.description: Configuration for the Airwallex-hosted completion page. Only applicable when `ui_mode` is `HOSTED`.

id.description: ID of the Billing Checkout object.

invoice_data.description: The settings of invoice to be passed to the invoice creation upon completion of the Billing Checkout in `PAYMENT` mode.

invoice_id.description: ID of the invoice for the Billing Checkout in `PAYMENT` mode. Only applicable when the Billing Checkout is in `COMPLETED` status.

legal_entity_id.description: ID of the legal entity to be used as billing entity, which can be retrieved from the `legal_entity_id` field in the [Retrieve account details API](/docs/api/scale/accounts/retrieve) response.

line_items.description: A list of items the customer is purchasing.

linked_payment_account_id.description: ID of the linked payment account to collect payment. You can find this ID in the Airwallex web app > Settings > Account details, within the Account Information section.

locale.description:
A code, in IETF language format, that determines the language and formatting displayed to customers on the checkout UI, and can be one of: `AUTO`, `EN`, `ZH`.  
If set to `AUTO` the customer's browser locale is used.

additionalProperties.description: A set of string key-value pairs that you can attach to this object for storing additional information.

metadata.description: A set of string key-value pairs that you can attach to this object for storing additional information.

mode.description:
The mode of the Billing Checkout object, can be one of:  
`SUBSCRIPTION`: Set up subscriptions.  
`PAYMENT`: Accept one-off payments.`SETUP`: Collect payment details to charge your customers later.

payment_options.description: Payment settings of this Billing Checkout.

payment_source_id.description: ID of the Payment Source created when the Billing Checkout is completed.

return_url.description: The URL to redirect your customer back to after they authenticate or cancel their payment on the payment method's app or site, with payment status not confirmed.

status.description:
The status of the Billing Checkout object, can be one of:  
`ACTIVE`: The Billing Checkout is available for the customer to complete a purchase.  
`COMPLETED`: The Billing Checkout has been completed.  
`CANCELLED`: The Billing Checkout has been cancelled.  
`EXPIRED`: The Billing Checkout has expired.  
The status automatically changes from `ACTIVE` to `EXPIRED` after 1 hour if purchase has not been completed.

subscription_data.description: The settings of subscription to be passed to the subscription creation upon completion of the Billing Checkout in `SUBSCRIPTION` mode.

subscription_id.description: ID of the subscription for the Billing Checkout in `SUBSCRIPTION` mode. Only applicable when the Billing Checkout is in `COMPLETED` status.

success_url.description: The URL the customer will be directed to after the checkout completion.

ui_options.description: UI configuration for the hosted checkout page.

theme_id.description: ID of the theme to apply to this billing checkout, overriding the theme configured for its legal entity.

ui_mode.description:
The UI mode of the Billing Checkout, can be one of:  
`HOSTED`: Customers complete the checkout on an Airwallex-hosted page.  
`EMBEDDED`: Embed the checkout UI directly in your website or app.  
`ELEMENTS`: Build a custom checkout UI using Airwallex Elements.

updated_at.description: Time when the Billing Checkout was last updated.

url.description: The URL to the Billing Checkout. The value is only present when the status is `ACTIVE`.

billing_address.description:
Controls whether the billing address will be collected during checkout.
- `AUTO`: Billing address will only be collected when necessary. Specifically, when automatic tax is enabled, or tax_id is collected.
- `REQUIRED`: Billing address will always be collected.
Defaults to `AUTO`.

tax_id.description:
Controls whether the tax ID will be collected for business customer during checkout. One of `OPTIONAL_IF_SUPPORTED`, `DISABLED`, `REQUIRED_IF_SUPPORTED`.
- `DISABLED`: Tax id will not be collected.
- `OPTIONAL_IF_SUPPORTED`: Tax id will be optionally collected in the supported countries, by displaying a checkbox "I am purchasing as business".
- `REQUIRED_IF_SUPPORTED`: Tax id will always be collected if the country is in the supported list.
Defaults to `OPTIONAL_IF_SUPPORTED`.

Billing_CustomerDataCollection.description: Provides configuration for the Billing Checkout to collect information from customers.

display.description: Whether to display the Airwallex-hosted completion page after checkout is completed and before the customer is redirected to `success_url`.

Billing_HostedCompletionPage.description: Configuration for the Airwallex-hosted completion page. Only applicable when `ui_mode` is `HOSTED`.

days_until_due.description: Number of days from invoice finalization until payment is due.

default_tax_percent.description: The tax rate between 0 and 100(%) to be applied to invoices to be generated. The tax will be exclusive. Defaults to 0.

due_at.description: Due date set by the merchant for this invoice, if any.

memo.description: String used for merchants to share a custom message to their customers. Referenced as memo or invoice note in Webapp.

additionalProperties.description: A set of key-value pairs that you can attach to this object for storing additional information.

metadata.description: A set of key-value pairs that you can attach to this object for storing additional information.

Billing_InvoiceDataResponse.description: The settings of invoice to be passed to the invoice creation upon completion of the Billing Checkout in `PAYMENT` mode.

email.description:
The prefilled email of the customer.
If this field or a `billing_customer_id` with an email on file is provided, the email will be prefilled and will not be editable during checkout.
If neither is provided, Billing Checkout will prompt the customer to enter their email during the checkout process.

name.description:
The prefilled name of the customer.
If this field or a `billing_customer_id` with a name on file is provided, the name will be prefilled and will not be editable during checkout.
If neither is provided, Billing Checkout will prompt the customer to enter their name during checkout.

type.description:
Type of the billing customer, one of `BUSINESS` or `INDIVIDUAL`.
If not provided, an "I am purchasing as a business" checkbox will be displayed during checkout for the customer to self-select.

Billing_PrefilledCustomerData.description:
The prefilled information of the customer. Only applicable when `billing_customer_id` is not provided.  
Not applicable in `SETUP` mode.

discounts.description: List of discounts to be applied to the line items. Discounts of line items are applied before subscription or invoice discounts. Currently, only one element is supported.

price_id.description: ID of the [Price](/docs/api/billing/prices) object. Mutually exclusive with `rate_card_id`.

quantity.description: The quantity of the line item being purchased.

rate_card_id.description: ID of the [Rate Card](/docs/api/billing/rate_cards) object. Mutually exclusive with `price_id`.

rate_card_version.description: Pinned Rate Card version number. Present when `rate_card_id` is set.

tax_percent.description: The effective tax percent of this line item.

mode.description:
Controls whether the payment method can be saved for future use. Possible values: `ENABLED`, `DISABLED`, or `COLLECT_CONSENT`.  
`ENABLED`: The payment method will be saved for future use.  
`DISABLED`: The payment method will not be saved.  
`COLLECT_CONSENT`: The checkout UI asks the customer whether they want to save the payment method.

next_triggered_by.description:
Indicates who will use the saved payment source to trigger future payments. One of `MERCHANT` or `CUSTOMER`.  
If `MERCHANT`, a Payment Source is created for future use. If `CUSTOMER`, the payment method is saved only with the payment provider.

CheckoutPaymentMethodSave.description: Settings for saving this payment method for future use.

pay_by_invoice_enabled.description: Enables the option to "Request an invoice" for payment. After the customer confirms to pay with this option, the status of Billing Checkout will transit to COMPLETED, and an invoice will be generated. The invoice will inherit the payment_options of this Billing Checkout, and other configurations in invoice_data. Only applicable when mode is `PAYMENT`, and the type of the customer is `BUSINESS`.

payment_method_save.description: Settings for saving this payment method for future use.

payment_method_types.description:
Specify which payment methods to display on the hosted checkout page and set their display order. Only methods supported for the specified currency and the customer's country code will appear on the hosted checkout page.  
Possible enum values when mode is `SUBSCRIPTION`: `card`, `applepay`, `googlepay`, `alipaycn`, `alipayhk`, `dana`, `gcash`, `kakaopay`, `klarna`, `rabbit_line_pay`, `tng`, `truemoney`.  
Possible enum values when mode is `PAYMENT`: `afterpay`, `airwallex_pay`, `alfamart`, `alipaycn`, `alipayhk`, `applepay`, `atome`, `au_pay`, `axs_kiosk`, `bancontact`, `bigc`,`bitpay`, `bkash`, `blik`, `boost`, `card`, `cash_app_pay`, `dana`, `doku_ewallet`, `dragonpay`, `duit_now`, `d_barai`, `enets`, `eps`, `esun`, `family_mart`, `fps`, `fpx`, `gcash`, `giropay`, `googlepay`, `go_pay`, `grabpay`, `hi_life`, `ideal`, `indomaret`, `jenius_pay`, `kakaopay`, `klarna`, `konbini`, `korean_local_card`, `laybuy`, `line_pay`, `linkaja`, `maxima`, `merpay`, `multibanco`, `mybank`, `narvesen`, `naver_pay`, `online_banking`, `ovo`, `p24`, `paybybankapp`, `payco`, `payeasy`, `payeasy_atm`, `payme`, `paypal`, `paypay`, `paypost`, `paysafecard`, `paysafecash`, `paysera`, `payu`, `pay_now`, `perlas_terminals`, `permatanet`, `permata_atm`, `pix`, `poli`, `prompt_pay`, `rabbit_line_pay`, `rakuten_pay`, `safetypay`, `samsung_pay`, `sam_kiosk`, `satispay`, `seven_eleven`, `shopee_pay`, `skrill`, `sofort`, `spei`, `tesco_lotus`, `tng`, `toss_pay`, `truemoney`, `trustly`, `twint`, `upi`, `venmo`, `verkkopankki`, `wechatpay`, `zip`.  
Possible enum values when mode is `SETUP`: `card`.

recurring.description: The billing cycle for recurring charges.

starts_at.description: Time when the subscription started or scheduled to start. Defaults to start immediately after creation.

trial_ends_at.description: The end time of the trial if applicable.
